headline: Mistakes to Avoid When Cleaning Up Small Fire Damage
articleBody: Cleaning up after a small fire can feel urgent, but making rushed decisions can actually lead to bigger problems. Here are some common mistakes to sidestep: 1) Don't delay contacting your insurance company; doing so can complicate your claim. 2) Avoid using regular household cleaners on soot – they can spread the damage and embed stains. Professionals use specific solutions. 3) Don't ignore smoke odor; it permeates everything and needs specialized treatment to be truly removed, not just masked. 4) Never turn on your HVAC system if there's smoke residue, as it can spread soot throughout your entire property. 5) Don't assume visible damage is the only damage – smoke and ash can cause corrosion and damage structural components out of sight. 6) Lastly, don't try to tackle everything yourself if you're not sure how; fire damage cleanup requires expertise.
